jobs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the16 exact Velvet game sprite poses in IMAGE1 with the crisp premium anime SD anatomy and rendering of IMAGE2. IMAGE1 is authoritative for pose, direction, hand position, boot/leg mechanics, equipment count/design and visibility. IMAGE2 is ONLY large skull/face-to-body ratio, shorter compact body/limbs, thick chunky black boots, clean ink and rich cel-shaded detail; DO NOT copy its poses OR its triple claw weapon. Velvet identity: long black-purple hair, red eyes, red/black torn coat, black strappy outfit, black boots, one white-bandaged normal forearm. EQUIPMENT MUST FOLLOW IMAGE1: exactly ONE silver triangular forearm BLADE with a RED inset on the black armored arm, opposite arm has WHITE BANDAGES and a small normal hand. No second blade, no giant claw on the bandaged arm, no triple claws from the style sheet. When weapon hidden behind body/hair in source, keep it hidden. 4columns x5rows, exactly16 whole figures in first4rows, bottom row empty transparency. Native1122x1402 if possible; safe separate silhouettes with20px transparent gaps and15px outer margin. Same head and boot anatomical scale across poses; crouching/lying characters naturally have lower total height, do not normalize bbox height. The row-major directions front/back/right/left and source face exposure must stay exact; no mirroring poses. Give each blade enough safe gutter without shortening it or changing hand grip. Genuine transparent alpha0 background. No floor, shadows, VFX, text, borders or extra figures. High quality fresh drawing, no enlargement filter/blur.
Rows in IMAGE1: row1 idle with blade lowered beside armed forearm; row2 low lunging slash/windup with armed elbow extended and opposite bandaged arm held back; row3 blade held diagonally across chest/in front of face, normal bandaged hand supports guard; row4 tighter defensive guard with vertical raised blade. Preserve source orientation of the ONE blade in each side pose, including when it points opposite body facing. Back column hair obscures face, side columns show face as source.
jobs.visualReview: Directly viewed16poses against reference: idle, lunging slash, chest guard and higher defensive guard preserve front/back/right/left and source blade orientation. Exactly one silver/red forearm blade; opposite white-bandaged normal arm retained. Larger SD skull/short torso/thick boots align visually to premium. No extra blade/claw or apparent clipping. Component128/actual-render verification pending.
